text:
maya: FYI — third-party PT kickoff scheduled for Tue 09:00 UTC. Scope: RBAC changes, KMS integration, audit logging, and a couple of web vuln endpoints. Need ops + infra + product on standby for evidence handoff.

arjun: noted. Can we lock down the exact RBAC playbook? I want to avoid granting long-lived perms.

maya: yes — plan is ephemeral assessor roles + read-only log export. Main asks: 1) a temporary role for the assessor w/ KMS decrypt/list only, 2) a sanitized log export path, 3) a snapshot of production audit logs for last 30 days.

liz: for KMS we should use a proxy key that we rotate before/after the window. avoids exposing customer keys. I'll prepare a key alias and a scoped policy.

sam: what duration are we giving assessors? 4h? 6h?

maya: assessor said up to 6h per window. Prefer 3x 6h windows over two days.

arjun: OK. We'll create an ephemeral role via our identity provider (OIDC) and limit session to 21600s. Example command for them:
```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-ephemeral --role-session-name pt-run --duration-seconds 21600
```

maya: include a machine-readable ACL so they can't request broader perms. Also need acceptance from compliance for evidence handling. @liz can you draft the policy?

liz: on it. Draft snippet I'll use for review:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:DescribeKey","kms:Decrypt","kms:ListKeys"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/alias/pt-proxy"}]
}
```

sam: audit logging question — do we supply raw CloudTrail or sanitized exports? Assessors requested raw for fidelity but product wants PII redaction.

maya: compromise: provide raw logs in the readroom with no external network egress, and a sanitized export bundle for general evidence. Assessors can request raw slices via a jump-host session (supervised).

arjun: implementable. We'll also enable an extra audit stream to S3 with object-lock for the window, retention 90 days. Sam, can you add a log-redaction checklist to the ticket?

sam: will add checklist to SEC-4321. Items: remove user emails, mask tokens, confirm IP preservation, keep request ids.

assessor-bot: assessor handshake confirmed — lead is @acme-pt-team. They requested proof of key-rotation policy and RBAC change logs.

maya: good. We need to capture RBAC change diffs (before/after) and signature from the owner. arjun — can the infra change be applied as an infra PR so it’s auditable?

arjun: yes. We'll open infra PR against infra-config repo, tag with PT window, and freeze merges from 08:00 UTC to 18:00 UTC on the day of the test. I'll add a CI gate that requires two infra-approvers for any change.

liz: also set up a canary key rotation right after the last window and snapshot key metadata. I'll upload key metadata to the evidence bucket.

maya: timeline recap: prep by Mon 17:00 UTC (policies, PRs), dry-run Tue 07:00 UTC, test windows Tue/Wed 09:00-15:00 UTC. Evidence packaging by Wed 20:00 UTC. Retest slots: Thurs same windows if needed.

sam: blockers: need a readroom VM and a sanitized dataset for exploratory testing. Who owns that?

maya: product will generate synthetic dataset. @product-sre (cc Liz), can you confirm?

liz: I can coordinate with product. Will publish a manifest of synthetic assets and upload to private S3 path: s3://redwood-pt/readroom/synthetic-v1/

arjun: small ops note — ensure KMS logs are forwarded to the secure SIEM stream; don't rely on CloudTrail alone. We should capture KeyUsage events.

sam: adding to checklist. Any special queries for SIEM?

arjun: add filters for kms:Encrypt kms:Decrypt kms:GenerateDataKey, IAM:CreateRole, IAM:AttachRolePolicy.

maya: remediation tracking — we'll use the existing SEC board with labels pt:high, pt:medium. After test, we need a 5-working-day SLT for critical CVEs. Add automatic assignment to oncall after triage.

assessor-bot: reminder: evidence upload window opens 1 hour after each test window.

maya: retention & compliance — compliance requires all evidence and logs for the PT kept for 180 days. Confirmed?

liz: yes, set 180-day retention on evidence bucket with access logs enabled. We'll produce a packaged export for assessors and the compliance pack.

sam: final item — retest coordination. If a fix is validated, we need a retest slot within 72 hours. Recommend keeping Thurs open for quick retests.

maya: agreed. Also capture regression tests in CI for any infra or RBAC change.

arjun: I'll create the infra PR, set the session duration, and freeze windows. ETA: EOD today for PR + CI gates.

liz: I'll post the KMS policy PR and the evidence bucket policy by Mon morning.

sam: I'll finish the log-redaction checklist and update SEC-4321 with readroom details and the retention policy.

maya: thanks team. Ping here if anything slips. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: readroom-vm build at 2025-06-02T06:00:00Z (job #deploy-782).
